text:
[LSTO.5.1] `cached()` is the only storage read in this edition, and it is
synchronous.

| Operation | Sync? | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `cached("k")` | **always sync** | cache = fast local read; async would eliminate the point |
| `cache` | sync | an engine-local write ([LSTO.4.7.1]); only the write-through is out of band |
| `cache_delete` | sync | same |
